info.title: Google Play Game Services Publishing API

requests.description: Delete the achievement configuration with the given ID.
requests.name: DELETE /games/v1configuration/achievements/{achievementId}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_PUBLISHING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
